szoveg_eredeti:
TELUS Digital is using ElevenAgents to cut early cancellations.

New TELUS internet customers were most likely to cancel before anyone from the company had spoken to them. So TELUS Digital built an ElevenAgents outbound voice agent that calls them in their first 90 days, explains their first bill, introduces self-serve tools, and shows customers with both home and mobile services how to link accounts and claim a discount.

Across roughly 2,300 calls in the proof of concept:
- 30-day cancellations were less than half the rate of the broader group of new customers
- TELUS estimates C$55,000 in lifetime revenue retained per 1,000 customers called
- Customers rated the calls 8.5 out of 10 on average
- The agent reached the right person as often as TELUS’ top outbound team members

“What this tells us is that the quality of the interaction matters as much as the timing,” said Jelena Bajic , Global Vice President, Global Operations Excellence at TELUS Communications .
